comment: C-first source-distinct monster-to-hero sleep candidate. monsters.h:PM_HOMUNCULUS defines AT_BITE/AD_SLEE 1d3; mhitu.c:hitmu dispatches a landed attack through uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping to mhitm_ad_slee, whose monster-to-hero branch can call fall_asleep after rn2(5), magic-negation, and Sleep_resistance checks. The v17 aggravate case wakes a sleeping monster, while this path can put the hero to sleep; direct make_stunned is a different effect. The recipe uses debug monster genesis followed by three elapsed waits so C can establish whether a bite reaches AD_SLEE. Inputs frozen before C or JavaScript comparison.
